weekly.overview: This week's energy is asking you to trust your gut instincts, Scorpio. Mercury's movement is blessing you with clarity about what actually matters. It's giving introspective, grounded vibes—perfect for releasing what no longer serves.
weekly.love: Your magnetic energy is peaked right now. If you're single, someone might be noticing. If coupled up, deep conversations are flowing naturally. Either way, vulnerability is your superpower this week. Let people see the real you.
weekly.career: You're getting major ideas and creative momentum. Channel that intense Scorpio focus into projects that genuinely excite you. Collaboration over competition is the move—your network has your back more than you realize.
